A file system in /etc/fstab, mounted now.

```hcl
step "example" {
  mount {
    fstype = "..."
    path = "..."
    src = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fstype` | string | Yes | File system type, such as xfs, ext4, nfs4 or tmpfs. |
| `on_remove` | string | No | "forget" (default) leaves it mounted, "delete" unmounts it and removes the fstab entry. |
| `opts` | string | No | Mount options. Defaults to "defaults". |
| `path` | string | Yes | Mount point. Created if missing. |
| `src` | string | Yes | Device, UUID=..., LABEL=..., host:/export, or tmpfs. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_mount.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the fstab entry matches and it is mounted. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_mount` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
